description:
We are a multidisciplinary team of students and educators from Cochabamba, a valley in the Bolivian Andes where farmers grow potatoes, maize, fava beans, wheat and alfalfa while facing frost, drought and increasingly late rains.

Our goal is to turn NASA data (NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, SMAP, MODIS NDVI) and local information from the Municipal Government of Cochabamba into a simple, Spanish-first web tool that ranks crop rotations by soil health, climate risk and each farmer’s priorities.
